evidence: Modifies `cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in` and `contrib/devtools/gen-manpages.py`, which is release and development documentation tooling.
rationale: Prevents generating and accidentally committing incomplete manpages when building with features like wallet or ZMQ disabled. As noted in issue #17506, 'gen-manpages output depends on build options, so needs to check them' to avoid shipping incomplete documentation with releases.
